title: Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City conducts medevac 143 miles off Cape Hatteras, NC
description: An MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City, North Carolina, conduct a medevac for a patient who was reportedly experiencing severe abdominal pain aboard a cruise ship 143 miles off Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, Aug. 9, 2019. The patient's wife and a ship's doctor were transported with him to Norfolk Sentara General Hospital to receive further care. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City)
